name: sample-lang
description: Sample registry entry: a synthetic Diode extension contributing the .diodesample language and its grammar
readme:
# Diode Sample Language

A synthetic entry that exists to prove the second shape of a `native` extension: a purely **declarative** one — it contributes a language and a TextMate grammar and ships no extension code at all, so it never reaches the extension host.

Opening a `.diodesample` file gives it the `Diode Sample` language, which the status bar shows. Nothing else happens, and nothing else is meant to.

Source and the deterministic packer live in the Diode repository (`e2e/marketplace/sample-extension`).
